reference_sql:
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')
GROUP BY brand
alternatives:
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')) AS n_products
FROM products
GROUP BY brand
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')) > 0
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products WHERE TRIM(LOWER(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs') GROUP BY brand
